name: medibrief-monorepo
description: MediBrief - Medical-record summarization and patient-education assistant

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@medibrief/shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@medibrief/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build --workspace=@medibrief/shared && npm run build --workspace=backend
